raw_veg_scraps.label: Raw vegetable scraps
raw_veg_scraps.action: Collect in a covered bin, kept apart from cooked food
raw_veg_scraps.destination: Compost pit, biogas unit or cattle-feed buyer

cooked_leftovers.label: Cooked leftovers
cooked_leftovers.action: Keep separate from raw scraps and hand over quickly
cooked_leftovers.destination: Biogas unit or animal-feed collector (not for human reuse)
cooked_leftovers.reroute: Compost if the feed pickup is missed

untouched_surplus.label: Untouched surplus food
untouched_surplus.action: Pack in clean containers straight away
untouched_surplus.tag: Safe to donate if packed and handed over in time

used_cooking_oil.label: Used cooking oil
used_cooking_oil.action: Filter, store sealed, never pour into drains
used_cooking_oil.reroute: Keep sealed and call the next collector

starchy_water.label: Starchy water (rice, dal)
starchy_water.action: Cool it and keep it apart from greasy water
starchy_water.destination: Water non-edible plants or moisten the compost

greasy_water.label: Greasy kitchen water
greasy_water.action: Pass through a grease trap before it reaches the drain
greasy_water.reroute: Clean the trap and call the septic service

packaging.label: Dry packaging
packaging.action: Rinse, dry and keep with dry recyclables
